events.title: Tupac Shakur's Tragic Anniversary
events.blurb: On September 1, 1996, influential rapper Tupac Shakur was shot in Las Vegas, tragically passing away six days later.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering Tupac Shakur, who would have been 55 this year. His impact on music and culture remains undeniable.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix Anniversary
events.blurb: September 2nd marks the anniversary of the passing of legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix in 1970.

angles.name: Guitar Legend Tribute
angles.copy: A true pioneer who redefined the electric guitar. Remembering Jimi Hendrix, who would have been 84 this year, and his incredible musical legacy.

events.title: Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album on September 4, 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. What's your favourite track from this masterpiece?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, was born on September 7, 1951, and turns 75 today.

angles.name: Pretenders Frontwoman
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! An enduring voice and a true rock icon.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, former Oasis frontman, was born on September 21, 1972, and turns 54 today.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Happy 54th to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the swagger after all these years. What's your favourite Liam moment?

events.title: Imagine Album Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his iconic 'Imagine' album on October 1, 1975.

angles.name: Timeless Message
angles.copy: Over five decades since John Lennon's 'Imagine' album gave us a message of peace that still resonates today.

events.title: iPod Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple released the very first iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: Music Revolution
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? 25 years since the original iPod changed music forever. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated annually as James Bond Day, marking the release date of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Who's your favourite Bond, and what's the ultimate 007 theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles, was born on October 9, 1940, and would have been 86 today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the visionary John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message live on.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: British comedy legend John Cleese was born on October 27, 1939, and turns 87 today.

angles.name: Comedy Icon
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true master of comedy.

events.title: White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on November 2, 1968.

angles.name: Diverse Classic
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles' sprawling 'White Album' hit shelves. A double album full of diverse and groundbreaking tracks.

events.title: Freddie Mercury Anniversary
events.blurb: November 24th marks the anniversary of the death of Queen's iconic frontman, Freddie Mercury, in 1991.

angles.name: Legendary Performer Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled showmanship and voice of Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80 this year. Forever a champion.

events.title: Rubber Soul Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their influential album 'Rubber Soul' on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Pivotal Album
angles.copy: 61 years since The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' shifted the sound of pop music. A truly pivotal album.

events.title: John Lennon Death Anniversary
events.blurb: December 8th marks the anniversary of the assassination of John Lennon in 1980.

angles.name: Enduring Impact
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, whose peace-loving spirit and music continue to inspire generations.
